relevance.rationale: Read from the journal front matter: a q-operational-calculus paper constructing 2-variable q-Legendre polynomials from a generating function built on 0th-order q-Bessel-Tricomi functions C_0, deriving their series definition, q-differential equations, and q-multiplicative/q-derivative (quasi-monomiality) operators. The corpus does carry q-Bessel objects -- Jackson J_nu^{(1)}, J_nu^{(2)} in rem:brings-q-hyperbolic-geometry and Hahn-Exton J_nu^{(3)} in the ladder coefficients, with prf:q-bessel-second-order-qdifference as the operative statement -- but what it needs from them is contiguity recurrences adapted to the SU_q(1,1) Casimir, not a new orthogonal-polynomial family. Corpus greps for 'Legendre', 'Tricomi', 'quasi-monomial' and 'q-dilatation' return nothing in content/, docs/ or computations/. Scope-(a): this document, as read, supplies nothing the corpus consumes; it is not a claim that q-operational methods are excluded from the q-Bessel front.

proposedActions.rationale: No corpus object wants a q-Legendre family or the C_0 Tricomi normalization; the live q-Bessel need is the Jackson/Hahn-Exton contiguity recurrence, which this paper does not address.
